aluminum_bulk_modulus.name: Bulk Modulus of Aluminum
aluminum_bulk_modulus.description: Calculate the bulk modulus of Aluminum by applying small finite deformations to compute the elastic tensor, then obtain the bulk modulus using the Voigt averaging method. Use Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential and the given parameters for the simulation. Report the bulk modulus in GPa units.

silicon_bulk_modulus.name: Bulk Modulus of Silicon
silicon_bulk_modulus.description: Calculate the bulk modulus of Silicon by applying small finite deformations to compute the elastic tensor, then obtain the bulk modulus using the Voigt averaging method. Use reaxff potential and the given parameters for the simulation. Make sure to include charge equilibration using fix qeq/reaxff. Report the bulk modulus in GPa units.
